title: OpenRouter Image Model Explorer
description: Browse and analyze available image generation models and their parameters.

pluginFunctions.name: List All Image Models

openaiSpec.name: list_models
openaiSpec.description: Retrieve a list of all available image generation models with technical details.

pluginFunctions.code:
async function list_models(p){const r=await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/images/models',{headers:{'HTTP-Referer':window.location.origin||'https://typingmind.com','X-Title':'TypingMind Plugin'}});if(!r.ok)throw new Error(`Failed to fetch models: ${r.statusText}`);const d=await r.json(),m=d.data.filter(x=>x.id!==null&&x.name);return{cards:m.map(o=>{const a=o.architecture||{},im=a.input_modalities||[],om=a.output_modalities||[];let t='Image Generation';im.length&&om.length?t=`${im.join(' + ')} → ${om.join(' + ')}`:om.length===1&&om[0]==='image'?t='Text → Image':0;const s=o.supported_parameters||{},pl=[];if(s.aspect_ratio){const v=s.aspect_ratio.values||[];pl.push(v.slice(0,4).join(', ')+'('+((v.length>4)?'+ '+String(v.length-4):'')+')');}if(s.resolution){const rv=s.resolution.values||[];rv.length>0&&pl.push('Res: '+rv.join(', '));}if(s.n){const mx=s.n.max||1;pl.push(mx>1?'Multi: up to '+mx+' images':'Single image');}s.seed&&pl.push('Fixed seed');if(s.quality){const qv=s.quality.values||[];qv.length>0&&pl.push('Quality: '+qv.join(', '));}if(s.background){const bv=s.background.values||[];bv.length>0&&pl.push('Bkg: '+bv.join(', '));}if(s.output_format){const fv=s.output_format.values||[];fv.length>0&&pl.push('Format: '+fv.join(', '));}s.input_references&&pl.push('Reference images');const tg=[],desc=(o.description||'').slice(0,150)+((o.description||'').length>150?'...':''),mid=o.id||'',idT=mid?`
[id: ${mid}]`:'';o.top_provider?.is_preference&&tg.push('Recommended');o.tags?.length&&tg.push(...o.tags);!tg.length&&o.description&&o.description.length<50&&tg.push(o.description);return{type:'content',title:o.name,subtitle:t,content:desc+idT,tags:tg,labels:[{label:'Capabilities',color:'blue',value:pl.slice(0,3).join(' · ')||'Basic'}],links:[{label:'Details',url:'https://openrouter.ai/'+(o.slug||mid.replace('/','-'))}]};});};}

pluginFunctions.name: Get Model Endpoints

openaiSpec.name: get_model_endpoints

modelId.description: The model slug/id (e.g., bytedance-seed/seedream-4.5). Find it on model cards as [id: ...].

openaiSpec.description: Fetch technical endpoint details for a specific model.

pluginFunctions.code: async function get_model_endpoints(params,userSettings,authorizedResources){const modelId=params.modelId;if(!modelId)throw new Error('Please specify a Model ID.');const res=await fetch(`https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/images/models/${modelId}/endpoints`,{headers:{'HTTP-Referer':window.location.origin||'https://typingmind.com','X-Title':'TypingMind Plugin'}});if(!res.ok)throw new Error(`Could not find endpoints for ${modelId}.`);const data=await res.json();return{cards:data.data.map(ep=>({type:'list_item',title:ep.type,content:ep.url,tags:[ep.status==='available'?'Online':'Offline'],labels:[{label:'Region',color:'gray',value:ep.region||'Global'}]}))};}
